steps.speaker: Adriel
steps.content: Die, traitor!
BOOM—Several steel bars pierce through the assassin's chest.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Adriel!! Ugh—!

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Arienna!!
[War Entrance]

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: ...It's you... the one from DisCity...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Does it have to be this way... To you, are Outlanders just... meant to die?

Several gunshots crack through the air, cutting her off mid-sentence. A man lunges from behind the ruins—one hand clutching a terminal playing Thalia's livestream, the other gripping a crude, makeshift gun. More people follow, stepping in front of Sibilla to form a shield.

steps.speaker: Harry
steps.content: Sibilla!!

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Who the **** are you?!! Killing people in broad daylight—you got no respect for the law?! Syndicate is no longer a place for ******* like you to run wild! Back the hell off! BACK OFF!

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: I've called the cops!! I've already called the cops!!!
She snatches up a steel pipe and swings at the masked man with furious, unrelenting force, each blow producing metallic clangs through the air.

steps.speaker: Harry
steps.content: Who are you? Stay back! You'll regret messing with Syndicans!

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: ...If you're going to hide her, do it right.

steps.speaker: Iron-Masked Man
steps.content: Don't let her run away and get herself killed again.
He turns and walks away. After a long silence, Sibilla hears a whimper.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Cough cough... Cough... Sob...
She rushes over to Arienna.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Hold on, just hold on! We're going to save you. I—
Before she can finish, Arienna suddenly grabs her by the collar.

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: ...I get it... I really do... We're the same... So please, I beg you, don't ruin...

steps.speaker: Arienna
steps.content: Fraser is our only... ho... pe...
Her hand finally falls limp.

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Please... no... wake up...

steps.speaker: Sibilla
steps.content: Sob... AAAAHHHHH!!!

steps.speaker: Sable
steps.content: What happened? This is...!!

Sable rushes to the scene, only to stumble upon a grisly tableau of blood and chaos. For a heartbeat, she freezes, stunned. But just as swiftly, she steels herself. With practiced hands, she takes out some fabric and starts tending to Sibilla's wounds.

steps.speaker: Sable
steps.content: I've stopped the bleeding for now, but we need to move her quick. She can't stay here—this is too much for her to take.

steps.speaker: Sable
steps.content: The safe house might be blown already. We need to go somewhere else.

steps.speaker: Sable
steps.content: Any news from Parfait?
Her companions shake their heads. They've been trying to reach Parfait through their network, but her terminal stays busy—jammed, perhaps, by interference.
Has she seen Thalia's stream? Does she know what has happened to Sibilla?

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Sibilla, pull yourself together... Let's head back first.

steps.speaker: Gracelyn
steps.content: Right now, keeping you safe is the most important thing.
On the eve of Parfait's Dinner Party, the investment guru makes her entrance. The servants discreetly usher away extraneous personnel, leaving her alone in the cavernous banquet hall.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Earlier today, an Outland extremist disrupted the peace at the Great Expo. During their arrest and subsequent transport, their associates launched an attack on the escort vehicle, tragically claiming the life of a sheriff in the line of duty. We are deeply saddened by this profound loss, but we will not waver in our resolve.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: Both Fraser and DisCity have implemented enhanced security protocols for the Expo. Every precaution has been taken to ensure tomorrow's closing ceremony proceeds without incident...
Before her rests an expensive glass of whiskey, a meticulously plated dinner menu, a neat stack of asset reports, and... several sticks of incense. Unlit, yet somehow, they begin to smolder.
Through the swirling smoke, Parfait can faintly hear the voices of her "friends."

- Was Fraser behind the Expo incident? If the 9th Agency gets involved, it could derail our plan. We can't risk losing those resources and assets from the Farland Alliance. - Oh, it's just a minor hiccup, nothing to worry about! My uncle already talked to the Outland Affairs Bureau, and Fraser's playing nice. They're basically handing us everything on the extremists—full life stories and all. - Is the opposition to the new mine handled? Without that big public fight, Parfait's advocacy alone might not be enough to sway DisCity's sharper minds. - We need more of our people in the Executive Committee. Get our actors moving too. They're not being paid to do nothing.

- Speaking of actors, let's talk about something more pleasant. None of this is really a big deal. I heard Parfait was at that dancer's performance too. She didn't get to buy her? - I had my eye on that dancer too. Too bad that Chief got to take her away—again. - Don't worry, we'll get another chance. Once I bring her back, we can set up a private show with that woman. Maybe even slip the Chief a free ticket.

- The Farland Alliance has been hit hard lately, calamity after calamity. They're desperate for Hypercubes, which means we can push our purchase prices way down. - You're absolutely right. Let's jump on this and make a killing. - Those pathetic little city-states are too scattered. Otherwise, we wouldn't even need Fraser's involvement.
The glass shivers—and inside, wreathed in rippling amber, a gaunt figure takes shape.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Your health still worries me. I found some curious Outland remedies at the Expo. Care to try? ...No promises, of course.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Heh, thanks. Chatting with you is always such a delight.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: You didn't attend the meeting today. Did something happen? Many people were lining up to speak with you.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Back to your home in the slums again?

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Yeah. Everything about "Parfait Medici" can be gloriously displayed in public, but those memories of just "Parfait" have to stay locked away in that little house, never to be found out. And I have to visit from time to time to make sure they're still safe.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Heh, why not just throw it all away? You've been so careful about hiding your identity, yet you keep your biggest risk around—can't bring yourself to let go of that old place.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: To have your "elegant life," you always have to give something up, you know.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Well, I am the stock market guru, after all. A touch of greed is only natural. But don't worry, I haven't slacked off. In fact, after a few rounds of promotion, Nirvana stock has hit another all-time high. I'm sure people in the organization are more than pleased with their returns.
Sillage gives a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: By the way, someone's lit the incense asking for our help. A certain representative from Fraser. He said...

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: A rat has escaped into DisCity, an inconvenience that could disrupt his plans. He's hoping to use the Sillage Society's hand to track it down.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Relax, I never promised we'd help him. Last time when you went all around WhiteSands and still brought that spy butler back to hide, I didn't say anything, did I? I've never been fond of "Campbell" anyway. As for cooperation... let's just do the bare minimum and call it a day.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Honestly, the only thing worth looking forward to lately is your dinner party tomorrow. So many of our friends will be there, after all.
The woman's voice drifts softly from the wine glass.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: You really are something else, Parfait. You have this way of winning people over without even trying. I like that about you, and that's exactly why I gave you the power, to let you more freely command "credit."

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: But you know how it is—"trust" is fragile. Once lost, it's very difficult to gain back.

steps.speaker: Sillage
steps.content: Tomorrow's dinner party... You won't let me down. I trust you.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Of course. At the dinner party, everyone will have their fill of delights.
The incense burns down to its final ember. Ethereal smoke, once lingering in the air, thins to nothing. And in the wine glass before her, Parfait's own face reappears.
At her dinner party, everything has a price tag—resources, technology, suffering, and war.
How much is this face, this identity worth now?
If its value were to plummet, how useful could it still be?
She sets down the wine glass, falling silent.

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Is it the member who takes on missions you trust...

steps.speaker: Parfait
steps.content: Or the stock market guru of DisCity...?
Having reached a conclusion, she picks up the wine glass and drains it in a single gulp.
Though at 300,000 DisCoins a glass, it truly pales in comparison to those homemade drinks shared with friends from a few nights ago—warm with laughter and barely 100 DisCoins apiece.
